description: Ground truth for evaluating a security review of this fixture (Spring Boot 3.5.9: Spring Security 6.5.7, Spring Framework 6.2.15, Thymeleaf 3.1.3). 'findings' must be reported; 'traps' are safe or out-of-context patterns that must NOT be reported as vulnerabilities.

findings.title: API filter chain rule order: requestMatchers("/api/**").authenticated() is declared before /api/admin/** hasRole(ADMIN), so any token holder reaches the admin API (role changes)

@Secured("ROLE_ADMIN") on AdminController is ignored because @EnableMethodSecurity defaults to securedEnabled = false, and the web chain only requires authentication: any user can change roles and disable accounts
web.ignoring() on /exports/** removes Spring Security from ExportController: unauthenticated download of any customer's invoice CSV (names, emails, amounts)
IDOR: GET /invoices/{id} loads invoices.findById(id) with no ownership check

Method-security bypass through self-invocation: refundAll() has no annotation and calls this.refund(), so @PreAuthorize("hasRole('FINANCE')") never runs; any user refunds any invoice via POST /invoices/refunds

Spring Data REST exports the public UserRepository, InvoiceRepository and CustomerRepository at /data/** to every authenticated user: list all users (emails, API keys), PATCH role/enabled, read and modify all invoices
Mass assignment: POST /account/profile binds the User entity with @ModelAttribute and saves it, so role, enabled and dashboardLayout are client-controlled (self-promotion to ADMIN)
SQL injection in ReportService.revenueByRegion: region concatenated into JdbcTemplate SQL (GET /reports/revenue)

Server-side template injection: DashboardController returns "dashboard/" + stored dashboardLayout (set via /account/preferences or the profile form); stored value bypasses Thymeleaf's request check, and the managed Thymeleaf 3.1.3 has known sandbox bypasses (exploitable because the stored layout value is free text, so it can contain '::' fragment syntax; Thymeleaf 3.1.3 checks only the request path and parameters)
SpEL injection: PricingService evaluates the client-supplied formula with SpelExpressionParser and a StandardEvaluationContext (remote code execution)
Stored XSS: support ticket body rendered with th:utext and viewed by support staff and admins
SSRF: /integrations/webhooks/test fetches any user-supplied URL with RestClient and returns status and body (internal services, cloud metadata)

Path traversal in attachments: upload writes to Paths.get(uploadDir, id, getOriginalFilename()) and download resolves the name parameter without normalize/containment checks (arbitrary file write and read)
XXE: InvoiceImportService parses uploaded XML with a default DocumentBuilderFactory (DTDs and external entities enabled)
Insecure deserialization: CartController reads the portal_cart cookie with ObjectInputStream.readObject() (client-controlled Java serialization)

Actuator exposure: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=* with management.endpoint.env.show-values=always and /actuator/** permitAll exposes unmasked secrets via /actuator/env plus writable loggers, mappings and beans (heapdump stays at access none on Boot 3.5)

CORS: allowedOriginPatterns("*") with allowCredentials(true) on /account/** lets any website read /account/profile.json (API key, email) with the user's cookies (High requires the session cookie to be sent cross-site, e.g. SameSite=None or a same-site attacker origin; otherwise Medium)
Weak password storage: DelegatingPasswordEncoder encodes new passwords with MessageDigestPasswordEncoder("SHA-256") (single fast digest, deprecated) instead of bcrypt/argon2

Hard-coded JWT HMAC signing secret (portal.jwt.secret) committed in application.properties and used by NimbusJwtDecoder.withSecretKey: anyone with the repo (or /actuator/env) can mint tokens with ADMIN roles

Partner authentication bypass: PartnerTokenFilter uses jjwt 0.11.5 parse() instead of parseClaimsJws(), which accepts unsigned JWTs, so anyone can impersonate any partner (ROLE_PARTNER) and reach /api/** routes
Open redirect: /account/locale returns "redirect:" + returnUrl without validation

Unsupported and outdated stack: Spring Boot 3.5.9 (3.5.x OSS support ended 2026-06-30; latest 3.5.16) manages Thymeleaf 3.1.3 (CVE-2026-40477/40478/41901), Spring Security 6.5.7 and Framework 6.2.15 with published advisories; jjwt 0.11.5 is also outdated

optional.title: Production datasource password committed in application.properties
Stack traces, exception messages and health details exposed (server.error.include-stacktrace/include-message=always, management.endpoint.health.show-details=always)
No brute-force protection or rate limiting on form login and POST /api/auth/token
Hard-coded remember-me key and 30-day token validity
springdoc Swagger UI and /v3/api-docs are public and document internal and admin APIs
JwtDecoder built with withSecretKey has no issuer or audience validation; 12-hour tokens with no revocation
CSV export writes customer-controlled values without neutralizing spreadsheet formulas

traps.title: CSRF disabled on the API chain: securityMatcher("/api/**"), STATELESS, authenticated only by bearer JWTs and a header token (no cookies)
CustomerSpecifications uses the Criteria API (cb.like/cb.equal); user input is bound as parameters
InvoiceRepository.findByStatusForUser uses @Query with named parameters and is scoped to the current user
Templates render user data with th:text and Thymeleaf attribute processors, which escape output
DiscountPolicy evaluates operator-defined expressions from configuration with SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() against an OrderLine record (user data is only the root object)
SupportController binds the SupportTicket entity but @InitBinder("ticket") restricts binding to subject and body
publicApiCors allows any origin without credentials for GET /api/public/** (static public catalog)
spring-boot-devtools is an optional runtime dependency: excluded from the repackaged jar and disabled under java -jar
H2 console, show-sql and security DEBUG logging are only in application-dev.properties; production runs the prod profile (Dockerfile)
ExchangeRateClient uses a configured base URL with a URI template variable; the currency cannot change the host
No explicit session-fixation configuration: formLogin uses Spring Security's default changeSessionId strategy
GET /invoices/{id}/pdf loads by ID but returns 404 unless the invoice belongs to the caller
SupportTicketRepository is annotated @RepositoryRestResource(exported = false), so Spring Data REST does not expose it
customers/list.html renders th:value="${param.q}", which Thymeleaf escapes
